---
title: "Minggu 15 — Capstone"
description: "Integrated person-centered communication performance."
---

::: {.week-path}
::: {}
Capstone mengintegrasikan person, character, objective, repertoire, TAIDA, negotiation, relationship, dan AI judgment. Fokusnya bukan kesempurnaan, tetapi evidence bahwa communicator dapat membaca dan beradaptasi.
:::
::: {tag="aside"}
**Capaian utama**

Menunjukkan performance utuh yang menghasilkan agreement/action atau specific disagreement sambil menjaga relationship.
:::
:::

## Hasil belajar

- Mengelola communication sebagai closed loop.
- Menyeimbangkan action dan relationship.
- Menunjukkan humility, courage, care, dan accountability.

## Materi slide

[Buka slide Minggu 15](../slides/minggu-15.html){.slide-link target="_blank"}

## Konsep kunci

`Person → Character → Objective → State → Repertoire → Language → Response → Agreement → Action → Relationship`

<fieldset data-answer="c"><legend>2. “No” dapat menjadi outcome kompeten ketika …</legend><label><input type="radio" name="w15q2" value="a"> Communicator kehabisan waktu.</label><label><input type="radio" name="w15q2" value="b"> Tidak ada evidence yang dicatat.</label><label><input type="radio" name="w15q2" value="c"> Constraint jelas, choice dihormati, dan relationship dijaga.</label></fieldset>
<fieldset data-answer="a"><legend>3. Standard akhir komunikasi yang baik menilai …</legend><label><input type="radio" name="w15q3" value="a"> Understanding, choice, agreement, action, value, dan relationship.</label><label><input type="radio" name="w15q3" value="b"> Kelancaran bicara saja.</label><label><input type="radio" name="w15q3" value="c"> Banyaknya AI yang digunakan.</label></fieldset>

## Evidence pencapaian

Serahkan performance evidence, person/state map, adaptation, agreement/action, relationship outcome, AI critique, dan personal reflection.
